name: Python: N+1 query in a loop

inputFiles.content:
from app.models import Order, Customer


def order_summaries(user_ids):
    summaries = []
    for uid in user_ids:
        order = Order.objects.filter(user_id=uid).first()
        customer = Customer.objects.get(id=order.customer_id)
        summaries.append((order.id, customer.name))
    return summaries

diff:
diff --git a/app/services/orders.py b/app/services/orders.py
--- a/app/services/orders.py
+++ b/app/services/orders.py
@@ -1,9 +1,10 @@
 from app.models import Order, Customer
 
 
 def order_summaries(user_ids):
     summaries = []
-    orders = Order.objects.filter(user_id__in=user_ids).select_related("customer")
-    for order in orders:
+    for uid in user_ids:
+        order = Order.objects.filter(user_id=uid).first()
+        customer = Customer.objects.get(id=order.customer_id)
-        summaries.append((order.id, order.customer.name))
+        summaries.append((order.id, customer.name))
     return summaries

expectedFindings.description: Two queries run per user id inside the loop (N+1); the previous single filtered query with select_related was removed.
